name: ALLY 31 – Finanzen
description: Unterablauf der neuen Oberfläche (BA5): Finanzen – Belege, Zeiterfassung, Monatsbericht (Projekte über PK 2), Projektbudgets (über ALLY 13), Kundenüberblick. Liefert nur JSON (Seitenbeschreibung).

parameters.query:
SELECT s.person IS NOT NULL AS ok,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text IN ('belege', 'zeiterfassung', 'kundenueberblick') THEN ally_web_arbeit($1::text) END AS a,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text = 'belege' THEN arbeit_web_seite($1::text, 'belege_verbuchen', '{}'::jsonb) END AS b,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text = 'projektbudgets' THEN arbeit_web_seite($1::text, 'budgets', '{}'::jsonb) END AS w,
  -- BA10 (Migration 69): Belege mit Fehler (Seite Belege), letzte Kundenüberblicke der Person (Seite Kundenüberblick)
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text = 'belege' THEN belege_fehler_ui($1::text) END AS fe,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text = 'kundenueberblick' THEN ally_ergebnisse_ui($1::text, 'kundenueberblick', 5) END AS ue,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text = 'monatsbericht' THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', k.papierkram_id, 'name', k.name) ORDER BY lower(k.name)), '[]'::jsonb)
    FROM (SELECT papierkram_id, split_part(last_synced_hash, '|', 1) AS name FROM sync_mapping WHERE entity_type = 'customer' AND status = 'active') k WHERE k.name <> '') END AS kunden,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL AND $2::text = 'monatsbericht' THEN (SELECT w.ergebnis FROM ally_web_sitzungen w WHERE w.token_hash = s.token_hash AND w.ergebnis ->> 'art' = 'monatsbericht') END AS erg,
  CASE WHEN s.person IS NOT NULL THEN (SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(z.schluessel, z.wert), '{}'::jsonb) FROM ally_ui_zustand z
    WHERE z.person = s.person AND split_part(z.schluessel, '.', 1) = $2::text) END AS zustand
FROM (SELECT 1) x LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM ally_ui_sitzung($1::text) y WHERE NOT y.muss_pw_setzen) s ON true;
